evidence_required: A design note of no more than two pages with a decision table, the snapshot-volume arithmetic, and at least two explicitly rejected alternatives with reasons.

marking.criterion: Decision table covering continuous vs on-demand collection with triggers, privilege model with audit, and retention
Snapshot-volume arithmetic from the supplied snapshot sizes (about 141 KB typical, about 72 MB per 512-node sweep, about 26 GB per year of daily sweeps before compression)
Auto-drain versus page-a-human split justified in GPU-hours (false drain costs one node; missed straggler costs a share of the whole job)
At least two rejected alternatives with reasons
Baseline YAML versioned in Git, changed by reviewed pull request, rolled out in shadow mode or canary

title: Host health at ORION-XL scale
